answer_1.quote: We introduce a task-oriented evaluation setup where summaries are meant to allow an agent to perform downstream tasks without reading the longer source text.

answer_2.quote: Standard automatic evaluation methods for summarization rely on the idea that a good summary should have some (semantic) overlap with either a gold standard or the source text.

answer_4.quote: While the SummEval dataset provides only a very limited number of human judgments, it contains enough aligned source, and AI-generated summaries to evaluate the MI metric.
answer_4.guideline: The SummEval dataset provides human judgments along dimensions such as coherence, consistency, fluency, and relevance.
